question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/list request (jsonrpc 2.0, empty params) sent as its own request: no credential, no Mcp-Session-Id header, and no initialize on this connection; section (P6) of the artifact, sent 18:10:26Z

decoded.tools: two, counted by occurrences of "inputSchema" over the whole 5,938-byte response: resolve-library-id (title Resolve Context7 Library ID) and query-docs (title Query Documentation), the same two as on 2026-09-23
decoded.challenge-header-absent: the 2026-09-23 reading of this request carried a WWW-Authenticate challenge on its 200 (Bearer, then resource_metadata naming https://mcp.context7.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource), as did the keyless initialize of 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-23 and the keyless tools/call of 2026-09-29. This response carries NO www-authenticate header; the CORS Access-Control-Expose-Headers value still names WWW-Authenticate
decoded.statelessness: the server answered a tools/list that followed no handshake on this connection and issued no session id, as before
decoded.not-measured: whether a credentialed caller is listed more than these two tools; whether any response (an error, a tools/call) still carries the challenge; when between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-09 it stopped
decoded.why-re-sent: Re-sent 2026-10-09 because the record of this request from 2026-09-23 (p-20260923-context7-mcp-tools-list-keyless) was filed before this prober kept transcripts and names no artifact; this one does. The tool list is unchanged; the challenge header is gone.
decoded.challenge-bounded: appendix (Q) of the same artifact, sent 18:18:36Z to 18:18:37Z: a keyless initialize (Q1, 200, serverInfo Context7 4.3.0) and a plain GET of the MCP path with Accept text/event-stream (Q3, 405) carry no www-authenticate header either, so on this day the challenge is absent from every keyless response measured, not only this one. The protected-resource metadata document the old challenge named (Q2) still answers 200: resource https://mcp.context7.com, authorization_servers clerk.context7.com and context7.com, scopes profile and email, bearer method header

finding: Sent with no credential and no preceding handshake, tools/list still answers 200 and lists exactly two tools, resolve-library-id and query-docs, so Context7's keyless surface is what it was on 2026-09-23. One thing changed: every keyless response measured from 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-29 (initialize, tools/list, tools/call) carried a Bearer WWW-Authenticate challenge on its 200, naming the protected-resource metadata URL, and on 2026-10-09 none of this tools/list, an initialize or a GET of the path carries it, while the metadata document itself still answers and the server's CORS exposure list still names the header. A client that read the earlier challenge as an invitation to authenticate now gets no hint from the server on the keyless path; the OAuth discovery document is reachable only to a client that already knows its well-known path. When it stopped, and whether any response still carries it, are not measured here.
